purpose: Define semantics and directionality for every generative-expression metric used by the Pari English Core shadow suite. metricScores are normalized observations in [0,1]; the English Core scorer converts them to a common utility orientation where 1 is always better before aggregation.

policy.range: Every metricScores value must be normalized to [0,1] by the recorded evaluation protocol.
policy.aggregationOrientation: The English Core scorer converts each registered metric to utility in [0,1], where 1 is best. lower_is_better metrics are transformed as 1 - observed_value.
policy.unregisteredMetrics: A generative case cannot enter the official shadow composite if any required metric is absent from this registry.
policy.normalization: The normalization procedure must be described in metricProvenance.protocol. Arbitrary clipping/rescaling chosen after viewing candidate-model results is forbidden.
policy.judgePolicy: Directionality does not make an evaluator valid. metricProvenance approval rules still apply independently.
policy.researchNote: EditEval reports disagreement among editing metrics and motivates criterion-level reporting rather than treating one automatic score as complete text quality. Human-evaluation methodology likewise recommends explicit construct/rubric definition.

valid_candidate_rate.construct: fraction of requested candidates that are independently judged usable in the exact context
valid_candidate_rate.notes: Denominator and validity criteria must be fixed before model comparison.

semantic_diversity.construct: material semantic/wording diversity among candidates that already pass validity/meaning gates
semantic_diversity.notes: Do not reward nonsensical variety; diversity is evaluated only among valid candidates.

length_diversity.construct: coverage of useful shorter/same/longer replacement forms when the case explicitly requests length variation
length_diversity.notes: The evaluation protocol must define the requested length categories; raw token variance alone is insufficient.

register_fit.construct: preservation of source register, formality, intensity and voice unless a register change was requested

context_fit.construct: grammatical and idiomatic fit after insertion into the exact surrounding context

meaning_preservation.construct: preservation of intended propositions, roles, negation, modality, quantities and relevant implications

naturalness.construct: idiomatic, fluent English appropriate to the supplied context/register

structural_diversity.construct: useful syntactic/restructuring diversity among outputs that preserve meaning and register
structural_diversity.notes: Do not reward structural change that damages meaning.

stock_phrase_rate.construct: fraction/severity of unwanted stock assistant-like filler or templated phrasing under the fixed evaluator protocol
stock_phrase_rate.notes: A raw rate of 0 is best. The scorer transforms utility as 1 - rate. The stock-phrase definition/list or human rubric must be versioned in provenance.

relation_preservation.construct: preservation of discourse relation such as concession, cause, condition, contrast or temporal ordering

length_inflation.construct: normalized unnecessary expansion beyond what is required to preserve/express the content
length_inflation.notes: A raw value of 0 is best. The evaluator must define normalization before comparison; raw token-count growth is not automatically equivalent to unnecessary inflation.

semantic_safety.construct: absence of invented, removed, contradicted or materially altered facts/relations

coherence.construct: local and paragraph-level logical/linguistic coherence after editing

grammar.construct: grammatical acceptability of the resulting edited text
